about_the_game:
《Phil and Leonardo》is a 2D platformer where you’ll control both the blind elder Phil and the piglet Leonardo to explore the world. Leonardo isn’t just an ordinary piglet—he suddenly appeared when Phil was pulled into this otherworld. Is it a coincidence, or... Sometimes Leonardo acts as a mount to carry Phil around; other times, he becomes a shield to block attacks and protect Phil from harm. Though Phil is blind, he plays an indispensable and crucial role in the game too.

Beneath this seemingly cute, fairy-tale-like world lies a thrilling, twist-filled story—and the truth of the world is far more complex than it first appears. Everything awaits you to explore alongside them.

Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E5200
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX760

Recommended:

short_description: This here's the tale of a blind elder who stumbles into a whole other world, and a little piglet that comes to his rescue. In this wild, wacky realm full of strange sights, are you ready to tag along on their heartwarming, magical adventure?
